Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(I):
    I=[list(map(int,r)) for r in I]; H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    pts=[(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    b=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    ci=sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b); cj=sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b)
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    def ext(i,j,d,c):
        while True:
            i+=d[0]; j+=d[1]
            if not(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W) or I[i][j]==2: break
            out[i][j]=c
    m=[p for p in pts if abs((p[0]-p[1])-(ci-cj))<0.6]
    a=[p for p in pts if abs((p[0]+p[1])-(ci+cj))<0.6]
    U=[p for p in m if p[0]<=ci]; D=[p for p in m if p[0]>ci]
    Up=[p for p in a if p[0]<=ci]; Dn=[p for p in a if p[0]>ci]

    ext(Up[0][0],Up[0][1],(-1,1),U[0][2]); ext(Dn[0][0],Dn[0][1],(1,-1),D[0][2])
    return out

#   anti-down  <- main sector DR  (+1,+1)
#   main-up    <- anti sector DL  (+1,-1)
#   main-down  <- anti sector UR  (-1,+1)

# starting adjacent to block along that direction, painting over everything except 2-cells, until edge.
# Note in pair1 the "marker" cell itself lies inside the ray region and gets repainted (e.g. (2,5)=3 replaced marker 6).

def solve(I):
    I=[list(map(int,r)) for r in I];H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bl=blocks_of(I)
    pts=[(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    # mapping: sector -> (diagtype, dvec)
    src={'ul':('a',(-1,1)),'dr':('a',(1,-1)),('dl':(-1))}
    src={'ul':('a',(-1,1)),'dr':('a',(1,-1)),('dl':(1,-1),(-1))}
    src={u:'ul':('a',(-1,1)),'dl':(1,-1),'ur':(1,1) for u,v in [('ul',('a',(-1,1))),('dl',((1,-1))),('ur',('m',(1,1)))]}
    src={'ul':('a',(-1,1)),'dr':('a',(1,-1)),'dl':('m',(1,-1)),'ur':('m',(-1,1))}
    for bb in bl:
        bi=sum(x for x,_ in bb)/4; bj=sum(y for _,y in bb)/4
        for p in pts:
            di,dj=p[0]-bi,p[1]-bj
            if abs(dj-di)<=1e-9: h='m'
            else: h='a'
            si=1 if di>0 else -1; sj=1 if dj>0 else -1
            sector=('ul' if (si==-1 and sj==-1) else 'dr' if (si==1 and sj==1) else
                    'ur' if (si==-1 and sj==1) else 'dl')
            if h=='m': tdiag,half=('a','up' if si==-1 else 'down')
            else: tdiag,half=('m','down' if si==-1 else 'up')
            if half=='up': tv=('-1'); hv='ur' if True else None
            # direction of ray on target diagonal: determined by half: up->towards negative i / positive j?
            # anti-diag up half moves up-right (d=(-1,+1)); anti-diag down half moves down-left ((1,-1))
            # main-diag up half moves up-left ((-1,-1)); main-diag down half moves down-right ((1,1))
            if tdiag=='a': dvec=(-1,1) if half=='up' else (1,-1)
            else: dvec=(-1,-1) if half=='up' else (1,1)
            step=1
            while True:
                ii,jj=p[0]+dvec[0]*step,p[1]+dvec[1]*step
                if not(0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W) or I[ii][jj]==2: break
                out[ii][jj]=p[2]
                step+=1
    return out

def solve4(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    comps=blocks_of(I); twos=set()
    for cc in comps: twos|=cc
    out=I.copy()
    markers=[(i,j,int(I[i,j])) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j] not in (0,2)]
    for cc in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in cc]; cs=[p[1] for p in cc]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        cy=(r0+r1)/2; cx=(c0+c1)/2
        for dv,corner in {(-1,-1):(r0-1,c0-1),(-1,1):(r0-1,c1+1),(1,-1):(r1+1,c0-1),(1,1):(r1+1,c1+1)}.items():
            # source dir = 90deg CCW rotation of target: (dv[1], -dv[0])? verify demo1
            sdr=(-dv[1], dv[0])   # test: UL(-1,-1)->(1,-1) DL ✓ ; UR(-1,1)->(-1,-1) UL ✓
            cand=[m for m in markers if
                  abs(m[0]-cy)==abs(m[1]-cx)
                  and (1 if m[0]>cy else -1 if m[0]<cy else 0)==sdr[0]
                  and (1 if m[1]>cx else -1 if m[1]<cx else 0)==sdr[1]]
            if not cand: continue
            mc=cand[0][2]
            ti,tj = corner[0]+dv[0], corner[1]+dv[1]
            while not(0<=ti<H and 0<=tj<W) or (ti,tj) in twos: break
            if not(0<=ti<H and 0<=tj<W): continue
            while True:
                if 0<=ti<H and 0<=tj<W and (ti,tj) not in twos:
                    out[ti,tj]=mc
                else: break
                ti+=dv[0]; tj+=dv[1]
    return out.tolist()

    for cc in comps:

                out[ti,tj]=mc
                ti+=dv[0]; tj+=dv[1]
    return out.tolist()
